names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Ιουλίου, «Άγιοι Θεόδοτος, Θεοδότη, Δολινδούχ, Διομήδης, Ευλάμπιος και Ασκληπιάδης», with the rank word left off.

death.note: saint.gr heads each of the six «(; - 98)» and says they were taken by «τον βασιλιά Τραϊανό (98 μ.Χ.)» — the first year of Trajan's reign, which is the only year the page prints.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 3 июля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Диомида , Евлампия , Асклипиодота и мц. Голиндухи (II).»

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, a company of four which is four of the six this folder already stands in: the Russian line names Диомид, Евлампий, Асклипиодот and the martyr Голиндуха on the same menologion day as this folder’s Greek row, and marks them «(II)», the second century, where the folder holds 98 off saint.gr. `dates` UNCHANGED — the century and the year do not contradict each other and the line is not the finer witness. The two further members the corpus keeps on this day, `theodotus-3-july` and `theodote-companion-of-theodotus`, ARE NOT NAMED BY THE RUSSIAN LINE and took nothing. The entry carries four name links and NO life page at all. The day page prints no hymn under any of these four names. NO `ru` NAME FORM WAS STORED. The calendar gives this man nothing but a bare forename, in the genitive inside a company line and again as the whole of his name link, with no epithet on either; and that bare forename already folds onto `golinduhia-of-persia`, whose Serbian form is the same word — A DIFFERENT WOMAN: she is dated 587 and kept on the Julian 12 and 13 July, where this folder is one of the company of six the Greek 3 July heads and is dated 98. BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2's own case is the eleven folders sharing a bare «Петр», which the gate stops on. The form is withheld rather than made into a fold key asserting a reading of folders this day did not need, and it is named in the report for the author.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (1 October 2026).
